duel.heading: Duels
duel.teamBlurb: Two teams of two (up to four a side) on the same places, {hp} HP per team. Each round your team scores its best pin, and teammates see each other's pins as they go. Send the room code to three friends.
duel.raceBlurb: The same {n} places for both of you, on the map picked above. Whoever scores the most points over {n} rounds wins. Send your friend the link and press Ready.
duel.raceBlurbEra: The same {n} places for both of you, on the map and games picked above. Whoever scores the most points over {n} rounds wins. Send your friend the link and press Ready.
duel.hpBlurb: The same places for both of you, on the map picked above. {hp} HP each: every round, the lower score loses the difference. Send your friend the link and press Ready.
duel.hpBlurbEra: The same places for both of you, on the map and games picked above. {hp} HP each: every round, the lower score loses the difference. Send your friend the link and press Ready.
duel.turboInfo: Turbo: once one of you guesses, the other has {s} seconds instead of 15.

party.royaleBlurb: Up to {max} trainers on the same places. Lowest score each round loses a life ({lives} each); last trainer standing wins.
party.teamBlurb: Red team against blue, 2v2 (up to 4v4), {hp} HP a team. Your team scores its best pin, and you see your teammates' pins live.
party.label: Party · up to {max} trainers
party.host: You host: change the map, lives, timer and rounds in the lobby, then start when everyone is in.
party.badCode: Room codes are six letters and numbers.
